questions.answer: Routing is the process of selecting the best path for forwarding packets between networks.

questions.question: Can topological sorting be applied to graphs with cycles?
questions.answer: No. Topological sorting is only possible for Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs).

questions.question: What is a relation in the relational model?
questions.answer: A relation is a table consisting of tuples (rows) and attributes (columns).

questions.question: What is page replacement?
questions.answer: Page replacement is the process of selecting a memory page to remove when a new page must be loaded into a full memory.

questions.question: What is IPv4?
